product_manifest.base_transform: positive land 420*(1-exp(-raw/1800))+.025*raw; mix by smooth distance from frozen ocean-cell rectangles over one source spacing; ocean/negative unchanged

coordinates.boundary: finite half-open rectangle; clamped edge interpolation

limitations: finite whole-source prepare; no unbounded-world macro coordination
procedural ranges and lowlands, no erosion or river/lake topology
query interpolates a DEM; evaluate_geometry directly samples fixed geometry

source_inventory.limitation: raster face normals and thick-crust priors; no reconstructed tectonic history

profile.sampling: read-only raster query; interpolated points do not increase physical resolution

resource_measurement: perf_counter wall seconds; process RSS sampled every 10 ms, includes interpreter and imports; sampling can miss peaks; peak_wset is process lifetime when available

environment.python: 3.11.11 | packaged by Anaconda, Inc. | (main, Dec 11 2024, 16:34:19) [MSC v.1929 64 bit (AMD64)]

limitations: coarse morphology only; no new hydrology, lakes, climate, TD inference or Minecraft
finite source prepared as a whole; infinite incremental generation not validated
visual morphology requires human review; delivery checks do not certify naturalness
